title: The Mercy Knives
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.King Jordon's retainers were each buried with a mercy knife, and now they carry them through the tomb. Warden Maud Ferrow wants the knives back.

About

Given byWarden Maud Ferrow
Level11
LengthMedium
KindCombat skill unlocks
Quest points2
UnlocksThe Dagger weapon skill

What you need

  • Retainers Knife ×8

Steps

  1. Talk to Warden Maud Ferrow (outdoors near King Jordon's Tomb) to get the quest.
  2. Bring 8 retainer's knives to Warden Maud Ferrow (8) - Retainers Knife at 26, 263
  3. Defeat Odric the Knifeward inside King Jordon's Tomb
  4. Learn the dagger from Warden Maud Ferrow at 26, 263

Rewards

Reward
Gold350
Character XP16,000
Dagger XP279
Quest points2
ItemsIron Dagger
Unlocksthe Dagger weapon skill

Unlocks

The Dagger weapon skill: this quest is how you learn it (the dagger tome is retired). Once you have it you can wield daggers, the skill levels with the damage you deal, and it unlocks five special attacks along the way.

What Warden Maud Ferrow says

Warden Maud Ferrow: Eight. I'll wrap them and put them back in the coffins.

You: They didn't want to give them up.

Warden Maud Ferrow: They were sworn to guard the king's door. So was Odric the Knifeward, the captain of the knife-guard. He walks the catacomb on the third floor, near the stair down.

Warden Maud Ferrow: Put him down and the rest of them will lie quieter.

Warden Maud Ferrow: So Odric's resting at last. Good.

Warden Maud Ferrow: Take this one. My grandmother carried it at the king's door, back when the door still had a king behind it.

You: It's light.

Warden Maud Ferrow: That's the point of it. A dagger wants you close. Stay inside their reach, cut low, and step out before they can swing.

Warden Maud Ferrow: Go on, show me. Again, and lower this time.

Handing it in

"Stay close, cut low, and step out before they can swing."
